# Product

## Overview
_What is this product, and what does it do?_

## Problem
_What problem does this product solve, and for whom?_

## Target Users
_Who uses this day-to-day? Think roles and needs, not just company size._

## Value Proposition
_Why would someone choose this over doing nothing, or over a competitor?_

## Scope
_What's actually being built right now — and just as importantly, what's explicitly out of scope?_

## Success Metrics
_How will the team know this product is working, from a user's perspective — not a business KPI?_

## Current Priorities
_What is the team focused on right now, and why?_
